about: The land acknowledgement on the new-world title (title-intro.mjs), set like a film's opening card: each stanza a list of lines, shown as written. The title names the panel for screen readers; it is not shown. Pauses hold a breath after a word: which time it appears (from 1), the ms (replacing any shorter punctuation or stanza breath after it and any punctuation touching it) and, for a held word, the card rarity tier (level-tiers.mjs) whose colour its phrase takes on, climbing as the poem goes. Its phrase (`phrases`, by held word) is the words around it on its line that light with it; it lights once its last letter is written, its glow rising over glowInMs, and stays lit. A pause with no tier is a silence only, like the long hold before the carved box stanza.
title: Before this forest
stanzas: Before our forest, there was land.
Before our story, there were peoples
and who care for them still.
of the lands beneath our homes
and beneath the machines we use.
We honour, too, the voices old and living
Before you sits an intricately carved wooden box,
Open the box. The path is yours.
